notes.title: Gore! Melee! Performance! YEAH! Torilla tavataan!
notes.content:
[p]Your good old Van Mardigain get to beat up thugs with his good old toy that is relatively suspicious looking.. wonder what he is up to ? 

We also did a lot of fixes to performance as we now update the PC version mainly, and can bring more blood and gore into the game it really needs to take us back in time when ATTITUDE mattered the most!

Good action story needs more depth so we bring you more clues about the adventure and the world.. perhaps we have a sequel ? notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content: [p]Hi, Ohto from virtual dawn here. Here to inform yall that i have done many bug and performance fixes to pc and vr, of course there's always more to be done, but this should make your gaming experience more enjoyable! [/p][p]Have a great Sunday![/p]

notes.title: PC version release
notes.content: Hello yall! Now Vr and Non Vr Versions are available. Both come in the same purchase, no dlc needed. Both have varying gameplay mechanics, so we recommend trying out both!

notes.title: Final Steps AND Pc Flat Screen Support Confirmed!
notes.content:
The game has reached the final stages of development, and we will announce the release date soon. We've also decided to add non-VR support, since we've received many requests for it on social media.

Right now, the "Final Battle" (the last scene) of the game is nearly complete. After that, we'll begin testing the game before release. That's all for now! Have a nice day :)

A small sneak peak :o

notes.title: Devlog 2
notes.content:
Hello! Im Ohto from virtual dawn, this is quick new devlog to keep yall informed. 


I have been working hard on new bandit npc. 
And im very proud how it came out. The bandits take cover when fighting, and can do multiple attacks and other movements after that, from cover shooting to rambo shooting, and also grenade throwing.

Also Fps have been increased and a lot of new things have been added.
Thank you to all that have wishlisted so far!

notes.title: Devlog1
notes.content:
Hello! Ohto from Virtual Dawn here. I'm excited to announce that the game is in its final stages before extensive internal testing, followed by potential public testing with selected participants.
To stay updated, follow VD_Ohto on TikTok for the latest news about the game.
If everything goes according to plan, the game should be released in 2–3 months!
Until then, we’ll keep you posted.
